Subject: Quick: GCP Marketplace listing + procurement flow

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — our procurement and cloud teams liked the latency/cost story. We're ready to move forward with a GCP Marketplace listing and need a clear checklist for procurement approvals and SKUs so our finance team can generate a PO. Two quick asks: (1) what Redwood SKU mapping looks like for committed capacity vs on-demand, and (2) an outline of the GCP listing prerequisites (partner form, security docs, billing entity details).

Hi Jordan — great to hear and glad the team liked the demo. I'm looping in Marissa (sales ops) and Rishi (partnerships) who run the GCP marketplace onboarding and procurement coordination. Below is a short checklist and I'll attach the SKU mapping in my next note.

Immediate/required items for a Marketplace listing:
- Completed GCP Partner listing form (we can pre-fill most fields)
- Billing entity name + address + TAX ID for NimbleWorks (for invoice/PO)
- SKU mapping (on-demand SKU, reserved SKU, and committed-capacity SKU variants)
- SOC 2 summary + data handling appendix (we can provide our standard package)
- Listing assets (short description, deep link, logo, support contact)

Procurement timeline note: if you can share the billing entity and preferred SKU profile by 4/9, finance can issue PO by 4/15. Otherwise we can accept an initial PO for on-demand SKUs and amend post-listing.

Marissa — can you attach the SKU mapping and the partner form template? Rishi — any additional partner-side contacts at Google we should engage for co-sell?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none)

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Date: 2026-04-06 08:30 PDT
Subject: Re: Quick: GCP Marketplace listing + procurement flow

Hi all — attaching the SKU mapping and a filled example for a 12-month committed plan. Also attaching the partner intake PDF we send to GCP (gcp-partner-form.pdf).

Notes on the attached nimble-sku-mapping.xlsx:
- Column A: Redwood SKU code (RWI-ONDEMAND, RWI-RESERVED-1Y, RWI-COMMIT-12)
- Column B: Unit (token calls / vCPU-hour equivalence)
- Column C: MSRP and Partner-discount tiers
- Column D: GCP listing SKU label (what appears in marketplace)

Operational guidance: if NimbleWorks wants predictable spend, recommend RWI-COMMIT-12 with a 15% partner discount and commitment billing via marketplace (monthly invoice). If they want flexibility, on-demand listing works but partner co-sell margins differ.

Attachment: nimble-sku-mapping.xlsx; gcp-partner-form.pdf

1) Marissa: finalize SKU labels in the marketplace submission to match NimbleWorks' PO and publish RWI-COMMIT-12 as the primary recommended purchase. Confirm invoice cadence (we will set to monthly billing via marketplace unless finance requests otherwise). Target: submit listing 2026-04-13 EOD.

3) Legal/Finance (cc'd): prepare invoice template with NimbleWorks billing entity and TAX ID. We will use marketplace managed billing; Redwood will receive payment through GCP settlement.
4) Jordan/Procurement: we have the signed PO and will accept the RWI-COMMIT-12 mapping. If NimbleWorks needs any amendments to billing cadence, notify Marissa by 4/16.
